meanings.usage: 特指擅长攀登阿尔卑斯山脉的专业登山者
用于描述某领域最早进行探索、开创先例的人或事物
可指山的最高点，也可引申为最高级别的官方会议
正式用语，指经过努力实现目标或达到某个水平
书面语，强调风险极高、可能造成严重伤害的
通常因恐惧、寒冷或厌恶而不自觉地颤抖，常与at搭配
此处指主动招致不好的事，也可表示追求异性、博取关注
强调单个的、没有其他伴随的
正式用语，形容地区或人极度贫穷的状态
复合形容词，由名词+过去分词构成，表充满某个不好的事物的
可形容物品质量差，也可形容人的言行粗鲁
中性义指某地/某人拥有某个好的事物，贬义指夸耀、说大话
指归某个教堂管辖的当地居民
强调情况没有例外、总是如此

meanings.meaning: 适应了的（固定搭配为be accustomed to (doing) sth，表习惯于某事）

phrases.usage: 用于表示两个事物按比例同步变化，意为“越……就越……”

examples.en: The more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded.
examples.zh: 路线越难，就越被人们看重。

examples.en: The more you practice, the more fluent your English will be.
examples.zh: 你练习得越多，英语就会越流利。

phrases.usage: 指某个领域的初创、探索阶段，意为“在开创初期”

examples.en: In the pioneering days however, this was not the case at all.
examples.zh: 然而在登山运动的初创时期，情况完全不是这样。

examples.en: In the pioneering days of the Internet, few people could imagine its popularity today.
examples.zh: 在互联网发展初期，很少有人能想象到它如今的普及程度。

phrases.phrase: go out of one's way to do sth
phrases.usage: 意为“特地、格外努力做某事；刻意做某事”

examples.en: They did not go out of their way to court such excitement.
examples.zh: 他们并不是刻意追求这种刺激。

examples.en: The host went out of his way to make every guest feel at home.
examples.zh: 主人费尽心思让每位客人都感觉自在。

phrases.usage: 意为“切断、隔绝与……的联系”，常用被动形式

examples.en: Alpine villages tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains.
examples.zh: 阿尔卑斯山区的村庄大多是贫穷的村落，被高山隔绝了与文明世界的联系。

examples.en: The small town was cut off from the outside world due to the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 由于大雪，这个小镇和外界失去了联系。

phrases.usage: 意为“（就着饮料）把食物送下；冲洗”

examples.en: All washed down with coarse wine.
examples.zh: 所有食物都得就着粗劣的葡萄酒咽下。

examples.en: You need some water to wash down the medicine.
examples.zh: 你需要点水来把药送服下去。

phrases.usage: 意为“习惯于……”，to是介词，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home.
examples.zh: 对于那些习惯了在家吃七道菜的正餐、睡细亚麻床单的人来说。

examples.en: She is accustomed to jogging for half an hour every morning.
examples.zh: 她习惯了每天早上慢跑半小时。

grammar.title: the + 比较级，the + 比较级结构
grammar.structure: the + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子，the + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子
grammar.definition: 表示两个过程按比例同时增减，即前者变化的同时后者也随之发生相应变化 用于说明两个变量的正相关或负相关关系，前半句相当于条件状语，后半句是结果

examples.en: The more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded.
examples.zh: 路线越难，就越被人们看重。

examples.en: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish the task.
examples.zh: 你开始得越早，完成任务就越快。

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语
grammar.structure: 名词 + 过去分词短语
grammar.definition: 过去分词放在被修饰的名词之后，相当于一个被动语态的定语从句，表被动或完成的含义 当定语内容较长时，常把过去分词短语后置，避免句子头重脚轻

examples.en: Alpine villages tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains.
examples.zh: 阿尔卑斯山区的村庄大多是贫穷的村落，被高山隔绝了与文明世界的联系。

examples.en: The book written by my professor has been sold out nationwide.
examples.zh: 我教授写的那本书已经在全国售罄了。

original.en: It is true that during their explorations they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature, equipped in a manner which would make a modern climber shudder at the thought, but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement.
original.zh: 诚然，在探险过程中他们经常面临极度的困难和危险，他们的装备简陋到现代登山者一想就会不寒而栗，但他们并不是刻意追求这种刺激。

imitations.en: It is true that learning a new language takes a lot of time and effort, but the benefits it brings are priceless.
imitations.zh: 诚然，学习一门新语言需要投入大量时间和精力，但它带来的好处是无价的。

imitations.en: It is true that the team has made great progress this season, but they still have a long way to go to win the championship.
imitations.zh: 诚然，这支队伍本赛季已经取得了很大进步，但要赢得冠军他们还有很长的路要走。

patterns.pattern: It is hard for sb to do sth nowadays

original.en: It is hard for us to realize nowadays how difficult it was for the pioneers.
original.zh: 如今我们很难想象当初的先驱者们面临的是怎样的困难。

imitations.en: It is hard for young people nowadays to imagine how life was like without smartphones.
imitations.zh: 现在的年轻人很难想象没有智能手机的生活是什么样的。

imitations.en: It is hard for city dwellers nowadays to experience the quiet life in the countryside.
imitations.zh: 如今的城市居民很难体验到乡村的宁静生活。

patterns.pattern: For sb accustomed to..., sth must have been very hard indeed

original.en: For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home, the change to the Alps must have been very hard indeed.
original.zh: 对于那些习惯了在家吃七道菜的正餐、睡细亚麻床单的人来说，到阿尔卑斯山的这种生活转变肯定非常艰难。

imitations.en: For people accustomed to working in air-conditioned offices, doing physical work outdoors in summer must have been very hard indeed.
imitations.zh: 对于习惯了在空调办公室工作的人来说，夏天在户外做体力活肯定非常难熬。

imitations.en: For children accustomed to being taken care of by their parents, living alone in a new city must have been very hard indeed.
imitations.zh: 对于习惯了被父母照顾的孩子来说，独自在陌生城市生活肯定非常不容易。

lines.en: Modern alpinists try to climb mountains by a route which will give them good sport, and the more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded.
lines.zh: 现代登山运动员总想找一条能够给他们带来运动乐趣的路线来攀登山峰。他们认为，道路愈艰险愈带劲儿。

lines.en: In the pioneering days, however, this was not the case at all.
lines.zh: 然而，在登山运动的初期，全然不是这种情况。

lines.en: The early climbers were looking for the easiest way to the top, because the summit was the prize they sought, especially if it and never been attained before.
lines.zh: 早期登山者所寻找的是通往山顶的最方便的途径，因为顶峰特别是前人未曾到过的顶峰--才是他们寻求的目标。

lines.en: It is true that during their explorations they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature, equipped in a manner with would make a modern climber shudder at the thought, but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement.
lines.zh: 确实，在探险中他们经常遇到惊心动魄的困难和危险，而他们装备之简陋足以使现代登山者一想起来就胆战心惊。但是，他们并非故意寻求这种刺激，他们只有一个目标，唯一的目标--顶峰！

lines.en: They had a single aim, a solitary goal -- the top!
lines.zh: 我们今天很难想像昔日的登山先驱们是多么艰苦。

lines.en: It is hard for us to realize nowadays how difficult it was for the pioneers.
lines.zh: 除了泽曼特和夏蒙尼等一两个很快出了名的地方外，阿尔卑斯山山区的小村几乎全是高山环抱、与世隔绝的穷乡僻壤。

lines.en: Except for one or two places such as Zermatt and Chamonix, which had rapidly become popular, Alpine village tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains.
lines.zh: 那里的小客栈一般都很肮脏，而且跳蚤猖獗。

lines.en: Such inns as there were generally dirty and flea-ridden; the food simply local cheese accompanied by bread often twelve months old, all washed down with coarse wine.
lines.zh: 食物是当地的干酪和通常存放了一年之久的面包，人们就着劣酒吞下这种食物。

lines.en: Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers found shelter wherever they could -- sometimes with the local priest (who was usually as poor as his parishioners), sometimes with shepherds or cheese-makers.
lines.zh: 山谷里常常没有小客栈，登山者只好随遇而安。

lines.en: Invariably the background was the same: dirt and poverty, and very uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 有时同当地牧师（他通常和他的教民一样穷）住在一起，有时同牧羊人或制乳酪的人住在一起。

lines.en: For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home, the change to the Alps must have very hard indeed.
lines.zh: 无论住在哪儿，情况都一样：肮脏、贫穷，极其不舒适。
对于过惯了一顿饭吃7道菜、睡亚麻细布床单的人来说，变换一下生活环境来到阿尔卑斯山山区，那一定是很艰难的。

questions.q: What was the main objective of early mountain climbers?
questions.zh: 早期登山者的主要目标是什么？
questions.a: The summit — the top — was the prize they sought. The early climbers were looking for the easiest way to the top, especially a summit that had never been attained before.
questions.aZh: 顶峰——也就是山顶——才是他们寻求的目标。早期登山者寻找的是通往山顶最省力的途径，尤其是前人从未登顶过的顶峰。
questions.hint: 见课文第 3 句：the summit was the prize they sought...

questions.q: How did modern alpinists choose their routes, and how was a difficult route regarded?
questions.zh: 现代登山运动员怎样选择登山路线？艰险的路线受到怎样的对待？
questions.a: They try to climb mountains by a route which will give them good sport, and the more difficult the route is, the more highly it is regarded.
questions.aZh: 他们总想找一条能带来运动乐趣的路线登山；路线愈艰险，愈受推崇。
questions.hint: 见第 1 句 the more difficult..., the more highly it is regarded.

questions.q: What were the conditions in the Alpine villages and their inns?
questions.zh: 阿尔卑斯山区的村庄和小客栈条件如何？
questions.a: Except for places like Zermatt and Chamonix, the Alpine villages were impoverished settlements cut off from civilization; the inns were dirty and flea-ridden, and the food was local cheese with bread often twelve months old, washed down with coarse wine.
questions.aZh: 除泽曼特、夏蒙尼等少数地方外，阿尔卑斯山区的小村是与世隔绝的穷乡僻壤；客栈肮脏、跳蚤猖獗，食物是当地干酪和常放了一年之久的面包，就着劣酒咽下。
questions.hint: 见课文描写 settlements 与 Such inns as there were 的两句。

questions.q: Where did climbers find shelter when a valley had no inn?
questions.zh: 当山谷里没有客栈时，登山者在哪儿找到住处？
questions.a: They found shelter wherever they could — sometimes with the local priest, sometimes with shepherds or cheese-makers.
questions.aZh: 他们只好随遇而安——有时同当地牧师住在一起，有时同牧羊人或制乳酪的人住在一起。
questions.hint: 见第 9 句 climbers found shelter wherever they could...

questions.q: Why was the change to the Alps so hard for the early climbers?
questions.zh: 对早期的登山者来说，来到阿尔卑斯山区的生活为何如此艰难？
questions.a: Because at home they were accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets, but in the Alps they faced dirt, poverty and great discomfort.
questions.aZh: 因为他们在家里过惯了一顿饭吃七道菜、睡亚麻细布床单的生活，而在阿尔卑斯山区面对的却是肮脏、贫穷和极大的不舒适。
questions.hint: 见课文末句 For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners... must have been very hard indeed.

translation:
现代登山运动员总想找一条能够给他们带来运动乐趣的路线来攀登山峰。
他们认为，道路愈艰险愈带劲儿。
然而，在登山运动的初期，全然不是这种情况。
早期登山者所寻找的是通往山顶的最方便的途径，因为顶峰特别是前人未曾到过的顶峰--才是他们寻求的目标。
确实，在探险中他们经常遇到惊心动魄的困难和危险，而他们装备之简陋足以使现代登山者一想起来就胆战心惊。
但是，他们并非故意寻求这种刺激，他们只有一个目标，唯一的目标--顶峰！
我们今天很难想像昔日的登山先驱们是多么艰苦。
除了泽曼特和夏蒙尼等一两个很快出了名的地方外，阿尔卑斯山山区的小村几乎全是高山环抱、与世隔绝的穷乡僻壤。
那里的小客栈一般都很肮脏，而且跳蚤猖獗。
食物是当地的干酪和通常存放了一年之久的面包，人们就着劣酒吞下这种食物。
山谷里常常没有小客栈，登山者只好随遇而安。
有时同当地牧师（他通常和他的教民一样穷）住在一起，有时同牧羊人或制乳酪的人住在一起。
无论住在哪儿，情况都一样：肮脏、贫穷，极其不舒适。
对于过惯了一顿饭吃7道菜、睡亚麻细布床单的人来说，变换一下生活环境来到阿尔卑斯山山区，那一定是很艰难的。
title: Matterhorn Man
subtitle: 马特霍恩山区人

lead.question: 早期登山者历尽艰险登上顶峰，他们真正追求的目标究竟是什么？
lead.warmup: 今天，登山者偏爱最险的路线，路线愈难愈受推崇。可在一百多年前的登山运动初期，情况恰好相反：那时的人只想找一条最省力的路登上山顶，顶峰就是他们唯一的目标。本课把我们带回阿尔卑斯山区的拓荒年代，看看早期的先锋们如何在肮脏、贫穷、与世隔绝的山村里艰难跋涉，只为把顶峰踩在脚下。
goals: 掌握 climb / summit / Alpine / settlement 等登山主题词汇
理解并运用 the more..., the more... 比较结构
辨析定语从句与分词作定语，如 settlements cut off from civilization
会用 must have been 表推测、be accustomed to 等常用短语
lead.summary: 本课对比了两代登山者。现代登山者追求运动的乐趣，路线越难越受推崇；而在拓荒时代，先驱们只求以最省力的方式登顶，顶峰便是他们唯一的目标。他们冒着极度的危险，装备简陋得令今人一想就战栗，却并非刻意寻求刺激。课文还描绘了当时阿尔卑斯山村的穷困：肮脏、跳蚤猖獗的客栈，陈年的面包与劣酒，登山者只能投宿于牧师或牧羊人处。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：go out of one's way 意为不辞辛苦、特意，而非偏离道路；must have been 表对过去的肯定推测，不要误写成 must be。

exercises.q: 汉译英：路线愈艰险，愈受推崇。
exercises.a: The more difficult the route is, the more highly it is regarded.

exercises.q: 汉译英：现代登山者试图找一条能带来运动乐趣的路线登山，因为顶峰是他们寻求的目标。
exercises.a: Modern alpinists try to climb mountains by a route which will give them good sport, because the summit is the prize they seek.

exercises.q: 句型转换：将定语从句改为分词短语——Alpine villages tended to be settlements which were cut off from civilization.
exercises.a: Alpine villages tended to be settlements cut off from civilization.
exercises.note: 定语从句化简为过去分词

exercises.q: 填空：They often faced difficulties and dangers ____ the most perilous nature.
exercises.note: be of the + adj + noun 结构

exercises.q: 填空：For men accustomed to ____ (eat) seven-course dinners at home...
exercises.note: be accustomed to 接动名词

exercises.q: 改错：The change to the Alps must be very hard indeed.
exercises.a: The change to the Alps must have been very hard indeed.
exercises.note: must have been 表过去推测

exercises.q: 汉译英：山谷常常连一家客栈都没有，登山者只好找到哪里就住哪里。
exercises.a: Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers found shelter wherever they could.
exercises.note: wherever 引导从句，boast 表拥有

quiz.q: 现代登山者选择登山路线时，衡量标准是什么？
options: The shortest route to the top
The easiest route to the summit
The route that gives good sport — the harder, the better
The route with the finest mountain views
quiz.note: the more difficult..., the more highly it is regarded

quiz.q: 早期登山者真正寻求的是什么？
options: The easiest way to the top
The excitement of danger
A route that offers good sport
The chance to hunt in the mountains
quiz.note: summit was the prize they sought

quiz.q: 关于拓荒时代登山者的处境，哪项符合课文？
options: They deliberately looked for exciting dangers
They faced perilous dangers though ill-equipped, but did not court excitement
They were richly equipped and feared nothing
They never met any real danger
quiz.note: they did not go out of their way to court excitement

quiz.q: 下列哪项符合课文对阿尔卑斯山村的描写？
options: Every village had a comfortable inn
They were rich and rapidly became popular
Zermatt and Chamonix stayed completely unknown
They were impoverished settlements cut off from civilization, with dirty, flea-ridden inns

quiz.q: 山谷里没有客栈时，登山者怎样解决住宿？
options: They slept in tents in the open air
They gave up and went home
They stayed with the local priest, shepherds or cheese-makers
They built new hotels for themselves

quiz.q: 对过惯舒适生活的人来说，来到阿尔卑斯山区感受如何？
options: The change must have been very hard indeed
It was a pleasant and comfortable change
It made no difference to them
It was easier than life at home
quiz.note: accustomed to seven-course dinners and fine linen sheets
